split_strategy: Manual. The dominant failure mode is recruiting-an-employee asks ('hire a recruiter for our team', 'where should I post the role', 'in-house recruiter') sharing strong keyword overlap with B2B procurement positives. Three boundary negatives (N1 in-house engineer hire, N2 candidate-side, N3 in-house recruiter) in train; one (N9 career coaching) held out.
passing_rule: should_trigger=true → trigger_rate > 0.5 over 3 runs. should_trigger=false → trigger_rate ≤ 0.5.
